page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ab alife" in the catchword, read as "ab aliis" with [?]. The "202" at the top right edge is not clearly part of this page's text and has been left out. Long s is read as s throughout; words such as "factis" and "fane" are read with a real f, where the scan does not show a crossbar. "vel in speciem" is read as printed ("velin"), with a probable word division. Possible printing error: "vel in" for "vel in" as printed. The first word is "est" with a long s, printed as "est" in the transcription.
